artifacts.name: Ecosystem Governance & Registry
artifacts.description: Canonical ecosystem standard, central registry rules, conformance policies, and model onboarding lifecycle.
artifacts.readme_excerpt: Each maturity model retains ownership of its domain semantics, assessment methodology and scoring logic while conforming to shared organizational standards.

artifacts.name: Enterprise Digital Maturity Model
artifacts.description: Domain-governed enterprise digital maturity model with progression tiers, criteria gates, and OpenDEA crosswalks.
artifacts.readme_excerpt: Defines domains, dimensions, capabilities, criteria, progression levels, and domain-specific assessment terminology.

artifacts.name: Operational Autonomy Model
artifacts.description: Evaluates closed-loop operational autonomy, human-in-the-loop guardrails, and resilience across business operations.
artifacts.readme_excerpt: Independently versioned autonomy maturity model linked via explicit touchpoints and handshakes to enterprise transformation models.

artifacts.name: Evidence & Deterministic Scoring
artifacts.description: Shared assessment capability for evidence validation, indicator mapping, deterministic scoring rubrics, and audit reporting.
artifacts.readme_excerpt: Provides reusable assessment execution, evidence management, deterministic scoring, and reporting across models.

artifacts.name: Encyclopedia & Localization Hub
artifacts.description: Shared authoritative knowledge encyclopedia and multilingual/regional localization capability for model instruments.
artifacts.readme_excerpt: Supports authoritative model knowledge resources and localized terminology without altering underlying scoring rules.

artifacts.name: OpenDEA Reference Architecture
artifacts.description: Digital Enterprise Reference Architecture (DERA): L1 catalog assembling metamodel, tenets, guardrails, patterns, blueprints, and metrics.
artifacts.readme_excerpt: Provides end-to-end enterprise reference blueprints aligned with OpenDEA metamodel and guardrails.

touchpoints.label: Evidence Binding Touchpoint
touchpoints.contract_summary: Maps verified assessment evidence items to digital maturity criteria gates.

touchpoints.label: Telemetry Evidence Touchpoint
touchpoints.contract_summary: Binds operational telemetry logs to deterministic autonomy scoring rubrics.

touchpoints.label: Localized Instrument Touchpoint
touchpoints.contract_summary: Supplies localized questionnaires and glossary definitions without changing score math.

handshakes.label: Conformance & Registry Handshake
handshakes.contract_summary: Validates model conformance, SemVer compatibility, and central registry registration.

handshakes.label: Cross-Model Autonomy Handshake
handshakes.contract_summary: Exchanges governed capability findings and change-impact signals between sibling models.

handshakes.label: OpenDEA DERA-L1 Handshake
handshakes.contract_summary: Crosswalks enterprise maturity profiles to OpenDEA L1 guardrails, patterns, and blueprints.
